per_island_factor.grid: 0.70..1.40 step 0.0005 per island, maximise within-1% count

stat_modifier_coefficient_vs_health_perc.note: coefficient recomputed from Interpolations(Type=StatModifier, Use=1), product of Evaluate(TimeChunkIndex)

units.note: GetSpawnerOptimumTimingForCurrentMode divides OptimumTime (minutes, IsDays=0) by TimeChunkDurationMinutes to put it on the floor(TotalPlaytime/1440) day scale

weapon_heuristic_fit.parameters: 3 k_t + 5 M_r read off the 15 envelope rows (per-series minimum of hv/(cd*sv)); M_r then rounded to the rule 1/1.25/1.5/1.875/2.5

capture_hypothesis.note: best of up to 6 candidates per level: optimistic

consumers.BossSpawnService.BakeStatsForFloor: boss tower / quest mob stats; boss tower timing not tested here
consumers.QuestMobSpawnerService: ConvertDaysToOptimum (*30) then BakeStatsForFloor (/30) for IsDays steps; ConvertOptimumToDays only for IsDays=0 steps

spawner_window.early_offset_status: code port of SimulationConfig.GetReCalcOptimumTime; not checked against data (SpawnerBakeInfos has no ReCalc field)
spawner_window.early_offset_effective_rel: bakeTime = start + (2*rel - 0.5)*W  for rel < 0.5, L >= 11, only where OT == Apply(rel)

simulation.target_in_bracket_rule: islands unlocked by a minute gate (L-1 gate IsDays=0) compared in active minutes, others in real days
